themes.light: Default (:root). The -dark keys replace their base keys under prefers-color-scheme: dark; there is no manual switch.
themes.source: crates/anzu/src/ui/theme.rs LIGHT and DARK; caption colors are Windows 11's own.

display.purpose: The hero headline only; the second phrase is accent.

path.purpose: The output path panel; breaks anywhere.

body.purpose: Leads and section copy, 58 to 66ch. The hero lead uses 1.7 leading and 16px from 640px.

body-small.purpose: Table rows, fact descriptions, secondary links.

label.purpose: Navigation, quiet buttons, veil text. Primary actions are 15px bold; the wordmark 17px bold.

note.purpose: Hero facts, figure caption, footer, language switch.

micro.purpose: The strip above the window, the app's small size.

frame-caption.purpose: 12px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui. Scoped to the Windows 11 frame; not a site voice.

shadows.name: window-lift-light
shadows.purpose: The app window frame only, light theme.

shadows.name: window-lift-dark
shadows.purpose: The app window frame only, dark theme.

motion.name: ease-in-out-quart
motion.purpose: Travel: the download bar, the chip fold, the dots running the strip, the loading line.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Hero lead and actions; scroll-driven .s-rise for section text (entry 0% to 55%).

motion.name: unveil
motion.value: 1s ease-out-expo, clip-path inset from the bottom plus translateY(0.6em)
motion.purpose: The hero headline, phrase by phrase (0.1s, 0.22s).

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: Header items (staggered 0.05s to 0.3s), hero facts, the full-size layer (0.4s).

motion.name: slide-in
motion.value: scroll-driven, from opacity 0 and translateX(-1.5rem), entry 10% to 70%

motion.name: draw-y
motion.value: scroll-driven scaleY from 0, entry 25% to exit 55%

motion.name: fill
motion.value: scroll-driven scaleX from 0, staggered per stage
motion.purpose: The three track bars, one after another.

motion.name: type
motion.value: scroll-driven, from opacity 0, translateX(-0.75rem), blur(3px), staggered per segment
motion.purpose: The output path, segment by segment.

motion.name: mark
motion.value: scroll-driven, block from scaleX(0.4) and opacity 0.2; lines grow from scaleX(0), staggered
motion.purpose: The logo assembling in the name section.

motion.name: strip-dot-run
motion.value: 700ms ease-in-out-quart, fade in by 15% and out from 85%
motion.purpose: A dot travelling a strip line; one clone per run so overlaps stay visible.

motion.name: strip-chip-stagger
motion.value: 0.18s per chip; chip reveal 0.6s; fold 0.9s ease-in-out-quart
motion.purpose: Chips entering and folding away on demo events.

motion.name: download-bar
motion.purpose: The Kindle tile's bar filling on the download event.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations 1ms, delays 0, one iteration; smooth scroll off; the window waits for Play

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Gutters 32px, section padding up, hero lead 16px, step dot position, two-column steps and facts.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Header navigation shown; name section two-column.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Hero copy row and the who-does-what section two-column.

breakpoints.name: strip-grid
breakpoints.purpose: Strip loses its flow lines and hub; tiles become a two-column wrapping grid.

breakpoints.name: strip-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Strip one column; window caption title hidden.

breakpoints.name: window-small
breakpoints.purpose: JS sets data-small; the full-size button appears.

narrative.overview:
The site is the app's own world, not a marketing skin over it. Every voice is JetBrains Mono, the same two weights the app ships; the palette is the app's two palettes token for token (`crates/anzu/src/ui/theme.rs`), "Cold paper" in light and charcoal in dark, switched by the system preference alone. Surfaces are flat panels on a cool or charcoal ground, divided by 1 px lines and nearly square 3 px corners. Amber is the only accent and it is spent sparingly: the primary action, the logo badge, thin lines and running dots, one phrase of the headline.

The page has one object of weight, the real Anzu window compiled to WebAssembly, inside an HTML Windows 11 frame. It is the only lifted thing on the page and the only place the site borrows another system's look (the Windows caption). Around it the app's three-stage track (DRM, unlocked, EPUB in warn, accent and ok) is the recurring device: it marks the files in the strip above the window, runs down the flow section as its spine, and closes the page as three filled bars.

The page is framed top and bottom by the ink band, dark in both themes, as the app's own header is. Motion is entrance and narration, never ambience: each element arrives once through one of a few named movements, and the strip above the window moves only when the running app reports an event.
keyCharacteristics: One family, JetBrains Mono 400 and 700, tabular numerals everywhere.
Ink band header and closing band in both themes; content between them on bg with panel surfaces.
3 px corners and 1 px lines; the 8 px Windows 11 frame is the only rounder shape.
One shadow in the whole system, under the window.
The three-stage track in warn, accent, ok as the signature device.
Motion arrives once and is tied to what the element is.

rules.name: The App Palette Rule
rules.body: The site's colors are the app's palette. A new color enters the site only after it enters `theme.rs`.

rules.name: The Small Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber is never a ground or a large surface. It fills only the primary action, the small logo badge tile and the logo mark itself at any size; everywhere else it is a line, a dot, a ring or a phrase of text.

rules.name: The Track Colors Rule
rules.body: Warn means "still locked" and ok means "EPUB"; neither carries any other meaning on the site. Inside a track, accent stands for the unlocked stage; outside a track it keeps its accent roles.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Every site voice is JetBrains Mono at 400 or 700. No second family, no other weights. The Segoe UI in the window caption belongs to the Windows frame, not to the site.

rules.name: The No Shouting Rule
rules.body: No uppercase labels and no wide letter-spacing; tracking only ever tightens, and only on bold sizes.

rules.name: The One Lifted Object Rule
rules.body: Only the app window casts a shadow. Panels, tiles, buttons and bands stay flat; hover lifts a primary action by 1 to 2 px of translation, not by shadow.

dos: Do take every color from the app's palette, in both themes, with the ink band dark in both.
Do keep JetBrains Mono at 400 and 700 as the only family, tightening tracking (-0.015em to -0.035em) only on bold sizes.
Do use 3px corners and 1px lines for every site surface; reserve 8px for the Windows frame.
Do keep the window at its real 1180 x 760 size where it fits and scale it as a whole below that, with a full-size view when it drops under 0.75.
Do bring each element in once, through rise, unveil, fade, window-open, draw or slide-in, on the expo-out curve; tie scroll entrances to the section kind.
Do keep content visible without animation support and let reduced motion skip time-based entrances and wait for Play before starting the window.
Do size primary actions at 48px (36px for the compact header Download), button controls around the window at 44px, and keep the 2px accent focus ring on everything focusable.
donts: Don't build an HTML lookalike of the app's interface; the window is the app itself.
Don't fill a ground or a large surface with amber; it fills only the primary action, the badge tile and the logo mark.
Don't add shadows beyond the window's.
Don't use warn or ok for anything but the locked and EPUB stages of a book.
Don't use uppercase labels, wide letter-spacing or a second typeface on the site.
Don't add motion that loops for its own sake; the only repeating movements are the loading line and the strip, which follows the app.
